instruction: Launch VLC from the dock, open Tools > Preferences (Ctrl+P), set "Maximum volume displayed" to 200%, click Save, and close VLC.

verification.condition: Check that the file ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc exists and contains an uncommented line exactly "qt-max-volume=200".
verification.expected_result: VLC configuration shows qt-max-volume=200, indicating the maximum volume is set to 200%.
